TZ.describes: IANA timezone name such as Europe/Amsterdam, or empty for the machine's local time

DISPLAY_FORMAT.describes: clock format of the marker; anything containing a % is a strftime string

CONTEXT_FORMAT.describes: clock format of the time Claude is told

COLOR.describes: colour of the marker; NO_COLOR disables colour regardless

ELAPSED.describes: show how long the turn took

SLOW_AFTER.describes: colour the duration once a turn takes at least this many seconds

SLOW_COLOR.describes: colour used for the duration of a slow turn

IDLE_AFTER.describes: mark a gap of at least this many seconds between messages

DATE_ROLLOVER.describes: show the date on the first message after the session crosses midnight

SUBAGENTS.describes: stamp messages from subagents as well as the main conversation

TOOL_TIMING.describes: time individual tool calls; the only setting that costs anything per tool call rather than per message

HISTORY.describes: record each finished session; timings only, no message text, no paths

HISTORY_LIMIT.describes: how many recorded sessions to keep

INJECT_CONTEXT.describes: tell Claude the local time each prompt was sent
